create_Circa_dataset: create a Circa classification dataset instance with five label categories for yes/no/other answers
run_Circa_main: run the main function to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
load_Circa_dataset: load the CIRCA dataset from Hugging Face using the load_dataset method
map_Circa_hf_to_list: map a Hugging Face CIRCA dataset split to a list of input-output tuples
split_Circa_train_test: split the CIRCA training data into 80 percent train and 20 percent test sets
